notes.title: Playtest Update - Version 0.12
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced total punishment time from 180 seconds to 120 seconds
[*] Finishing quests now also considers (and prioritizes) item that is equipped by player, not only items in player’s inventory
[*] Prisoners now become aggressive if the player accesses their desk while being seen by the prisoner
[*] The view distance of NPCs is now effected (reduced) by rain/snow (20% reduction) and fog (30% reduction)
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed button click sound not playing when closing a minigame
[*] Fixed screws on toilet sometimes not being interactable
[*] Fixed toilet body name not being displayed when player looks at it
[*] Fixed another issue that caused the character UI being initially hidden
[*] Added cooldown to guard detection to avoid them from being stuck between detecting something and immediately losing interest
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented NPCs with low stamina from using melee weapons
[*] Fixed watch progression calculation not properly considering the watched character crouching
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update - Version 0.11
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Random daily items: every NPC now holds a random item in their inventory that changes every day
[*] New items: shaving cream and battery
[*] Rain now causes the electrical fence generator to be disabled
[/list]

[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added UI displays to show how many prisoners are in the escape zone and how much time is left for the escape to be successful
[*] Overhauled hotkeys for inventory items and added indicator to show current item hotkey slot
[*] Small improvements for join-lobby menu
[*] Added version number display to main menu
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused pop-up information text to be permanently stuck on screen, blocking further pop-ups
[*] Fixed input search field delay in join-lobby menu
[*] Fixed an issue that caused tutorial windows to overlap and be permanently stuck
[*] Fixed issue that could cause a cell door to not reopen again after the punishment time ended
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the player from saving properly
[*] Fixed helicopter not coming during lockdown
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the worker dealer inventory to not be set properly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused button inputs not being detected properly when changing controls
[*] Fixed character quest and dealer indicator not being hidden when character becomes unconscious
[*] Fixed weather particles and sound effects not working correctly
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] The sunlight color temperature now changes in correspondence with the air temperature
[*] Small sound volume adjustments
[/list]
